notes: Published to the intranet from 6ba59f46e4 on both platforms, then rolled back after Office document previews crashed with 0xC0000005 on a host whose system MSVCP140.dll predates the LibreOffice engine toolchain; exactly one client had installed it. The version identity is void and must never be republished under the same number. A later repin to 738afe65c5 (portable VC++ runtime fix) was reverted: the fix ships as 0.2.2-rc.1.20261107.1 instead, because a same-number republication could never auto-update the client that installed this build. Mac signed packaging for this record additionally required the HiBuddy artifact-promotion fix after the first notarized attempt failed on lingxi-office-* filenames.
